events.message: Hello, this is Cedar Table.

Hello, this is an automated assistant calling on behalf of Maya Chen. This call is being recorded. I need to cancel a dinner reservation for Maya Chen at Cedar Table Bistro on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 6:15 PM. Could you please check and cancel this reservation? If you don't find it at 6:15 PM, please also check for 5:45 PM and 6:00 PM under the same name.
Can I get the name of the reservation?
The reservation is under the name Maya Chen. Could you please confirm if you have found it and proceed with the cancellation? If you need any additional information, please let me know.
It is already canceled.
Thank you for confirming the cancellation. Could you please check if there are any other reservations for Maya Chen on October 29, 2026, at any time? If there are any, please cancel those as well.
Okay.

Could you please confirm if there are any other reservations for Maya Chen on October 29, 2026, at Cedar Table Bistro? If there are none, please let me know so I can confirm the completion of the cancellation process.
No, I do not have any other reservation.
Thank you for your help. I have the reservation for Maya Chen on October 29, 2026, at 6:15 PM canceled, and no other matching reservation remains. Goodbye.
